payload.summary: Fresh production build attempt 12912 completed both optimized WASM packages (52 legacy/51 canonical exports), validated Earshot references, HyperFrames packages and all eight background-removal assets, then stopped because I mistakenly selected the library package opencut-mcp instead of workspace app opencut-mcp-server. Cargo metadata confirmed apps/mcp owns BOTH opencut-mcp and opencut-session-policy binaries. Corrected build to opencut-mcp-server --bins, restored packaging of the session-policy executable with Windows suffix, and launch/smoke now default to the packaged native policy. Native policy spawn is hidden on Windows. Restarted full build in exec session 20490; cached WASM stage passed again, native release dependencies now compiling. No production release active yet. Configured legitate-only-local recheck passed at snapshot 172b86e4f0073ed8e618ff78d213e801bda857127259a366160486d77a1d6300 after these corrections. One pre-existing native-policy unit test skipped because its path assumes unsuffixed target/release; do not claim it passed. Prepared ignored native-policy-smoke.mjs to test the real compiled Windows binary and owner fence after Cargo finishes, and probe-production.mjs to verify active manager release, BUILD_ID, live compiled script SHA, strict API rejection and restored public asset SHA. Both under .local/legitate-only-setup. Real dev strict mode/API rejection already verified; rollback backups intact and source model deletions preserved.
